mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause additive renal impairment; tobramycin is aminoglycoside-related nephrotoxicity and posaconazole may impair renal function, increasing tobramycin accumulation and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) closely; consider tobramycin therapeutic drug monitoring and dose adjustment if renal function declines; evaluate alternative antifungal if possible.
